### ✨ New
- 📝 Release notes now show in sections (new, bug fixes, other) in the update window and the changelog

### 🧰 Other
- 🔌 The debug log now lists every USB device Android shows, with its ids and interfaces, to find out why a radio is not recognised
- 📻 An RTL-SDR stick with a tuner that is not supported yet now says which one (E4000, FC0013, FC2580 or FC0012) instead of "Could not open the radio"
